t: This augment can only be added to the $(l:modules/extruder_1)Extruder Mk1/$ and $(l:modules/extruder_2)Extruder Mk2/$ modules.$(p)It can be stacked; each augment increases the force that entities are shoved when the module extrudes a block.
这个增强件只能添加到$(l:modules/extruder_1)造桥模块 Mk1/$和$(l:modules/extruder_2)造桥模块 Mk2/$模块中。$(p)它可以叠加；每个增强件都会提高模块挤出方块时推动实体的力度。
